reviews.comment: Prof Das is so sweet and cares about her students. She puts a lot of time and effort into doing reviews/practice questions to prep for exams. Don't underestimate the midterms. Go over the practice exam and exam review sheet and you should be golden. The prof writes the final, which is very similar to the practice questions. Hw is very light.

She was an extremely caring professor, who obviously wants her students to succeed. Stats is not my strong subject, but I enjoyed this class way more than I thought I would. She does a good amount of review work during classes before exams and is open to any questions. There are attendance quizzes every class but she goes over the answers.

This was Professor Das' first semester teaching and I think she did great! Having taken AP stats before, none of the material was brand new to me, and she made the class a breeze. You can tell she cares about her students and enjoys the material she teaches. Go to class for attendance quizzes and do the practice exams she posts, they're great.

This was her first semester teaching, so I wasn't sure what to expect, but I'd highly taking Professor Das! She's caring and approachable, making it easy to ask questions. While the class is test-heavy, her in-class reviews and practice exams were a huge help. Attendance is required due to participation quizzes, but the workload is manageable.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things
